title: Resideo Launches Pro-IQ™ Predict, Bringing AI-Powered Predictive Intelligence to HVAC
summary: Resideo Launches Pro-IQ™ Predict, Bringing AI-Powered Predictive Intelligence to HVAC
body_markdown:
*Pro-IQ Predict uses connected-device intelligence to help spot HVAC system problems before they become breakdowns*


SCOTTSDALE, Ariz.


, Nov. 10, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- HVAC systems tend to break when homeowners need them most: on the coldest night or hottest day of the year. A homeowner is left uncomfortable and scrambling for help, while their HVAC contractor is fielding a surge of emergency calls. But what if AI could spot the warning signs before the system fails?[Resideo Technologies](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4818619-1&h=3019338944&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.resideo.com%2Fus%2Fen%2Fresideo-home%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dorganic_social%26utm_campaign%3Dpro_iq_predict_announcement&a=Resideo+Technologies) (NYSE: REZI), a leading global provider of solutions for home comfort, security and safety, today announced Pro-IQ™ Predict*, an AI-powered service that combines connected thermostat insights and patent-pending analytics to identify developing HVAC problems and alert the homeowner's HVAC contractor.


Informed by millions of connected Honeywell Home device interactions and a decade of HVAC system insights, Resideo's Pro-IQ Predict service can help identify and respond to more than 80 HVAC issues before they escalate, turning surprise furnace or air conditioning breakdowns into scheduled fixes.


"Our thermostats have kept homes comfortable for generations. Now, our latest Honeywell Home thermostats are among the smartest we've ever built, proactively helping homes run at their best," said Pat Tessier, Vice President of Product Management at Resideo. "With the Pro-IQ Predict service, we're turning thermostat and HVAC insights into actionable intelligence, putting meaningful information into the hands of the professionals who can help avoid system downtime. That's the future of AI in the home: trusted technology that anticipates problems, enables proactive service and helps prevent disruptions before they happen."


**From Reactive Repairs to Predictive Home Maintenance**


Designed to work across compatible residential HVAC system equipment, the Pro-IQ Predict service uses insights from the latest[Honeywell Home smart thermostat](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4818619-1&h=2870912728&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.honeywellhome.com%2Fpages%2Fsmart-thermostats%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dorganic_social%26utm_campaign%3Dpro_iq_predict_announcement&a=Honeywell+Home+smart+thermostat) to continuously examine performance. This helps contractors identify potential failures, diagnose issues remotely, prioritize service and make informed maintenance, repair and replacement decisions before the service call begins. Home service professionals can offer their customers earlier outreach from a trusted technician, fewer disruptions, fewer costly emergency repairs and greater confidence in one of the home's most critical and expensive appliances: their HVAC system.


The new service advances Resideo's strategy to move the connected home from reactive monitoring to proactive care, using AI, connected-device intelligence and professional expertise to identify potential issues before they disrupt the home. Professionals offering the service are already seeing the value. "Because we're able to have insight into our customer's HVAC system, we now have the ability to serve them better," said Paul Giglio, Jr., Owner of Pipe Works Services in Chatham, New Jersey. "People live busy lives, and they appreciate us knowing and fixing an issue before they realize there's a problem."


"AI can't replace the knowledge required to install a system or understand a home's unique comfort needs," added Tessier. "By putting AI-powered insights in the hands of contractors, we're complementing their expertise with a continuous view of connected equipment performance, freeing up more time for customer consultation and proactive service."


**Availability**


Existing HVAC professionals subscribed to Pro-IQ services can access predictive functionality through an over-the-air software update. Homeowners interested in predictive HVAC services can visit[HoneywellHome.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4818619-1&h=128324559&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.honeywellhome.com%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dorganic_social%26utm_campaign%3Dpro_iq_predict_announcement&a=HoneywellHome.com) to connect with a trusted local HVAC professional.


**About Resideo**
Resideo is a global building technologies company that is a leading developer and manufacturer of critical control and sensing solutions for residential markets. The company serves professional installers and integrators across diverse product categories, such as heating, ventilation and air conditioning controls, combustion, life safety, security and water. Its comfort and protection solutions can be found in more than 150 million residential and commercial spaces globally, with tens of millions of new devices sold annually. More information about Resideo and its trusted brands, including BRK, First Alert and Honeywell Home, is available at[Resideo.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4818619-1&h=3664816454&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.resideo.com%2Fus%2Fen%2Fresideo-home%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dorganic_social%26utm_campaign%3Dpro_iq_predict_announcement&a=Resideo.com) .
